review_description: Wasn't the cheapest of my 4 quotes but less than one other. Overall they could supply me with the brands that I wanted included in cost. Very good communication, not pushy or desperate. All the information I needed was supplied. Once decided I only had to wait 2 weeks. Was planning on 18 panels but measurements said 17. When the installers came there was room for 2 more so even better I now have 19. It's only been operating for 2 weeks after waiting for meter connection and my remote check up on Wi fi is showing the benefits big time. .
All aspects of the process were handled well. Quick prompt quote with helpful followup. Great installation when expected and great customer service.
